newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures rise in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures rise in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly higher in after-hours trade on Tuesday, as constant buying continued amid improved market sentiment, traders said.
Rubber futures ranged from flat to 0.8 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.5 yen up at 144.4 yen. Volume was 6,671 lots.

"Encouraged by falls in rubber stocks announced on Monday, buying interest increased," one trader said. "But further price gains in nearby months could be limited ahead of the spot expiry on next Monday," he said.
